title: The symptoms
text: The suffering you see in footage of animal use is real, and it is standard practice across the world. But it is a symptom, not the root. Much animal use produces no obvious suffering at all: backyard eggs, wool from sheep who graze happily, hand-milked goats, working dogs. The root injustice in all of them is the same: treating sentient beings as resources to be used. Veganism opposes that. Not because of how animals are treated, but because they are used at all. The root cause is the belief that animals exist for us to use. When that belief is rejected, the symptoms collapse with it. Veganism does not seek to reform these practices or make them more humane. It seeks to end the use of animals entirely.
